blog:
Daily life of an open-source advocate When I grew up as a child, I always wondered how these people managed to fucking run these fancy neovim setups and all these flashing windows moving around on their screen. I had this desire to find out what they were doing, ever since I was in the womb. Once I realised how much data every company is harvesting from you—I pivoted, and never came back—it's been the most wonderful journey I have experienced.
Ever since I was a child, I've been starting to love using Neovim more. I've realised how the corporate monopolies (Microsoft, Visual Studio Code) have actually been trying to HINDER our abilities to create things! YouTube—from Google has also been doing this, same with TikTok and all that typeof() stuff. Crazy, isn't it?? Here's a quote from when I was a child:
When I use Neovim—I will fucking surpass humanity, soar to the skies, climb to the top of the corporate ladder (i will even break the corporate ladder) to make more profit all because I have learned how to surpass humanity with the ultimate skill of editing text, blazingly fast. I will shift mountains, shift seas, and shift humanity towards a better future by editing their genome sequences and making everything software-based so it's more reliable than ever.
Crazy visions, crazy visions. Am I right? Wow. How insightful. This goal is ultimately too difficult to achieve though, and I don't think climbing the corporate ladder nor making profit is very useful. Infact, what happened with corporations? What? WHAT???
"Oh yes I love making money and oh yeah I'm just a corporation I need more money and uhhh... Yeah one time we killed a few people because.. Maybe not one time though.. Probably many times... We're humans right?? Humans make mistakes??? I mean... Or we might have killed more than a few people actually... But look at the human population! 8 billion people. These delicious metrics. I don't think we are a cause of danger, right? We're actually truly dedicated to safety—we would never harm anyone! We are so safe, and we care about our mission. Everyone loves our products! We just added another AI feature, it's quite lively we'd say—our stocks increased by 2% this quarter, which is a big sign that everyone is enjoying it. Look at our metrics! 95% shareholder happiness! Wow. Truly amazing." - yours, corporation. Anyways, back to my actual daily routine. In the mornings, I wake up from my LibreBed and they come with an pre-built blanket which is very cool. Normally, these beds are wayy too closed source. Infact, last week I just bought one of these amazing beds that feel sooo comfyyyy and the blankets they came with are sooo cozy and memory-safe! I configured it to my liking, better than a corporate bed could ever be—I can never go back now. After that, I brush my teeth with NeoBrush while I watch the lights flicker with my Anubi-Light.
